articles.abstract_en: Returns to labour mobility have too often escaped the attention they deserve as conduits of important forces in macro-labour models. These returns are shaped by calibrations of productivity processes that use theoretical perspectives and data sources from (i) labour economics and (ii) industrial organisation. By investigating earlier prominent studies, we conclude that the focus on firm size dynamics and shocks intermediated through neo-classical production functions in (ii) yields large returns to labour mobility that are robust to parameter perturbations. In contrast, the reliance on statistics in labour economics to calibrate per-worker productivity processes in (i) can give rise to fragilities in the sense that parameter perturbations that generate similar targeted statistics can have very different implications for returns to labour mobility.
articles.abstract_cn: 劳动力流动性的回报常常未能得到应有的关注，而它们作为宏观劳动模型中重要力量的传导渠道。这些回报受到生产力过程校准的影响，这些校准使用了来自（i）劳动经济学和（ii）产业组织的理论视角和数据来源。通过研究早期的重要研究，我们得出结论，在（ii）中关注企业规模动态和通过新古典生产函数中介的冲击，产生了对参数扰动具有稳健性的劳动力流动性的大回报。相比之下，在（i）中依赖劳动经济学的统计来校准每个工人的生产力过程，可能导致脆弱性，即产生类似目标统计的参数扰动可能对劳动力流动性的回报产生非常不同的影响。

articles.title_en: Measuring Social Benefits of Media Coverage: How Coverage of Climate Change Affects Behaviour
articles.title_cn: 衡量媒体报道的社会效益：气候变化报道如何影响行为
articles.abstract_en: It has been well documented that beliefs and actions can be affected by media coverage. In this paper, I study the effect of newspaper coverage of climate change on individual driving behaviour. I construct a measure of the tone of coverage based on comparisons between environmental and sceptical texts. I then use this measure, along with detailed information about driving patterns, to test whether households’ travel decisions are affected by the coverage that they have recently received. I find that coverage of climate change that uses an environmental tone causes households to make environmentally friendly travel decisions, particularly when good substitutes are available. Since driving is a major source of carbon emissions, these results illustrate a potential externality of media coverage.
articles.abstract_cn: 已有充分文献记载，信念和行动可能受到媒体报道的影响。在本文中，我研究了报纸对气候变化的报道对个人驾驶行为的影响。我基于环境主义文本与怀疑论文本之间的比较，构建了一个报道基调的衡量指标。然后，我利用这一指标以及关于驾驶模式的详细信息，来检验家庭的出行决策是否受到他们近期所接收报道的影响。我发现，采用环境主义基调的气候变化报道会促使家庭做出环保的出行决策，尤其是在有良好替代选择的情况下。由于驾驶是碳排放的主要来源，这些结果说明了媒体报道的一种潜在外部性。

articles.abstract_en: Using detailed information from lobbying reports filed under the Lobbying Disclosure Act, we construct a unique dataset that allows us to identify which firms lobby on free trade agreements negotiated by the United States, their positions (in favour or against) and their lobbying efforts on the ratification of each trade agreement. Using this dataset, we show that lobbying on free trade agreements is dominated by large multinational firms, which are in favour of these agreements. On the intensive margin, we exploit exogenous variation across free trade agreements to show that individual firms put more effort into supporting agreements that generate larger potential gains—larger improvements in their access to foreign consumers and suppliers and smaller increases in domestic competition—and that are more likely to be opposed by politicians. To rationalise these findings, we develop a new model of endogenous lobbying on trade agreements. In this model, heterogeneous firms select into trade and choose whether and how much to spend lobbying on the ratification of a free trade agreement, and politicians may be biased in favour of or against the agreement.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用根据《游说披露法》提交的游说报告中的详细信息，我们构建了一个独特的数据集，使我们能够识别哪些公司就美国谈判的自由贸易协定进行游说、它们的立场（支持或反对）以及它们在每项贸易协定批准上的游说努力。利用这一数据集，我们表明，对自由贸易协定的游说由大型跨国公司主导，这些公司支持这些协定。在集约边际上，我们利用自由贸易协定之间的外生变化来表明，个别公司会投入更多努力支持那些能产生更大潜在收益——即它们进入外国消费者和供应商的渠道有更大改善，而国内竞争增加较小——以及更可能遭到政界人士反对的协定。为了合理化这些发现，我们开发了一个关于贸易协定内生游说的新模型。在该模型中，异质性公司选择参与贸易，并决定是否以及花费多少来游说支持自由贸易协定的批准，而政界人士可能偏向支持或反对该协定。

articles.abstract_en: We study verifiable disclosure by a seller when the product has multiple quality attributes. We identify an equilibrium in which, for some qualities, the seller discloses its score—the average of the qualities—and does not reveal anything else. This occurs when its score is sufficiently high or when the qualities are sufficiently similar and the score is not too low. Otherwise, the seller fully discloses. While full unravelling is still an equilibrium, it is dominated by this partial score disclosure equilibrium in terms of ex ante as well as ex post profits.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了当产品具有多个质量属性时，卖方进行的可验证披露。我们识别出一个均衡，在该均衡中，对于某些质量，卖方披露其分数——即质量的平均值——而不透露其他任何信息。这种情况发生在分数足够高，或者质量足够相似且分数不太低时。否则，卖方会完全披露。虽然完全揭开仍然是一个均衡，但在事前和事后利润方面，它被这种部分分数披露均衡所支配。

articles.abstract_en: In many public policy areas, randomised policy experiments can greatly contribute to our knowledge of the effects of policies and can thus help to improve public policy. However, policy experiments are not very common. This paper studies whether a lack of appreciation for policy experiments among voters may be the reason for this. Collecting survey data representative of the Dutch electorate, we find clear evidence contradicting this view. Voters strongly support policy experimentation and particularly so when they do not hold a strong opinion about the policy. In a subsequent survey experiment among a selected group of Dutch politicians, we find that politicians conform their expressed opinion about policy experiments to what we tell them the actual opinion of voters is.
articles.abstract_cn: 在许多公共政策领域，随机政策实验可以极大地增进我们对政策效果的了解，从而有助于改进公共政策。然而，政策实验并不常见。本文研究选民对政策实验缺乏重视是否可能是原因之一。通过收集代表荷兰选民的调查数据，我们发现了明确的反驳这一观点的证据。选民强烈支持政策实验，尤其是当他们对该政策没有强烈意见时。在随后对一组选定的荷兰政治家进行的调查实验中，我们发现政治家会将其对政策实验的表达意见调整为我们告知他们的选民实际意见。

articles.title_en: Strategic Conformity or Anti-Conformity to Avoid Punishment and Attract Reward
articles.title_cn: 战略趋同或反趋同以避免惩罚和吸引奖励
articles.abstract_en: We provide systematic insights on strategic conformist—as well as anti-conformist—behaviour in situations where people are evaluated, i.e., where an individual has to be selected for reward (e.g., promotion) or punishment (e.g., layoffs). To affect the probability of being selected, people may attempt to fit in or stand out in order to affect the chances of being noticed or liked by the evaluator. We investigate such strategic incentives for conformity or anti-conformity experimentally in three different domains: facts, taste and creativity. To distinguish conformity and anti-conformity from independence, we introduce a new experimental design that allows us to predict participants’ independent choices based on transitivity. We find that the prospect of punishment increases conformity, while the prospect of reward reduces it. Anti-conformity emerges in the prospect of reward, but only under specific circumstances. Similarity-based selection (i.e., homophily) is much more important for the evaluators’ decisions than salience. We also employ a theoretical approach to illustrate strategic key mechanisms of our experimental setting.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提供了关于人们在被评估情境下（即个体必须被选中获得奖励（如晋升）或惩罚（如裁员）时）的战略性趋同及反趋同行为的系统性见解。为了影响被选中的概率，人们可能试图融入或突出，以影响被评估者注意到或喜欢的机会。我们在三个不同领域（事实、品味和创造力）中通过实验研究了这种趋同或反趋同的战略激励。为了区分趋同和反趋同与独立性，我们引入了一种新的实验设计，该设计允许我们基于传递性预测参与者的独立选择。我们发现，惩罚的前景增加了趋同，而奖励的前景减少了趋同。反趋同出现在奖励的前景下，但仅在特定情况下。基于相似性的选择（即同质性）对评估者的决策比显著性重要得多。我们还采用理论方法来阐述我们实验设置的战略关键机制。

articles.title_en: Technology Adoption, Mortality and Population Dynamics
articles.title_cn: 技术采纳、死亡率与人口动态
articles.abstract_en: We develop a quantitative theory of mortality and population dynamics, emphasising individuals’ decisions to reduce their mortality by adopting better health technology. Expanded use of this technology reduces the cost of adoption and confers a dynamic externality by increasing the future number of individuals who use the technology. Our model generates a diffusion curve whose shape dictates the pace of mortality reduction. The model explains historical trends in mortality rates and life expectancies at various ages and population dynamics in Western Europe. Unlike Malthusian theories based solely on income, ours is consistent with the observed disconnect between mortality and income. Unlike Beckerian theories of fertility, ours accounts for the observed acceleration in population.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个关于死亡率与人口动态的定量理论，强调个体通过采纳更好的健康技术来降低自身死亡率的决策。该技术使用的扩大降低了采纳成本，并通过增加未来使用该技术的个体数量而产生动态外部性。我们的模型生成了一条扩散曲线，其形状决定了死亡率下降的速度。该模型解释了西欧不同年龄段的死亡率、预期寿命的历史趋势以及人口动态。与仅基于收入的马尔萨斯理论不同，我们的理论与观察到的死亡率与收入之间的脱节相一致。与贝克尔式的生育理论不同，我们的理论解释了观察到的人口加速增长现象。

articles.title_en: Television and Academic Achievement: Evidence from the Digital Television Transition in the UK
articles.title_cn: 电视与学业成就：来自英国数字电视转换的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper exploits exogenous variation in the transition date from an analogue to digital television signal in the UK across more than 32,000 geographical units to examine the causal impact of television on academic performance and potential mechanisms. Using a large administrative dataset on the universe of students in public education in England, I show that the switchover increased pupil test scores and that the effect is driven by economically disadvantaged students. Using TV market data and a child survey dataset, I investigate possible mechanisms. I show that the digital transition considerably increased TV viewing time and displaced forms of socialisation associated with risky behaviour for disadvantaged children.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用英国从模拟电视信号向数字电视信号转换日期的外生变异，覆盖超过32,000个地理单元，考察电视对学业成绩的因果影响及其潜在机制。利用英格兰公立教育全体学生的大型行政数据集，我发现转换提高了学生考试成绩，且该效应由经济弱势学生驱动。利用电视市场数据和儿童调查数据集，我探究了可能的机制。我表明，数字转换显著增加了电视观看时间，并替代了与弱势儿童危险行为相关的社交形式。

articles.title_en: How do Workers Adjust to Robots? Evidence from China
articles.title_cn: 工人如何适应机器人？来自中国的证据
articles.abstract_en: We analyse the effects of exposure to industrial robots on labour market adjustments, exploring longitudinal household data from China. We find that a one-standard-deviation increase in robot exposure led to a decline in labour force participation (−1%), employment (−7%) and hourly earnings (−8%) of Chinese workers. At the same time, among those who kept working, robot exposure increased the number of hours worked by 8%. These effects were concentrated among the less educated and larger among male, prime-age and older workers. We also find that more exposed workers increased their participation in technical training and were significantly more likely to retire earlier.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们分析了工业机器人暴露对劳动力市场调整的影响，利用中国的纵向家庭数据。我们发现，机器人暴露的一个标准差增加导致中国工人的劳动力参与率下降（−1%）、就业率下降（−7%）和小时收入下降（−8%）。与此同时，在继续工作的人群中，机器人暴露使工作时间增加了8%。这些影响集中在受教育程度较低的工人中，并且在男性、壮年和老年工人中更为显著。我们还发现，暴露程度较高的工人增加了技术培训的参与，并且更有可能提前退休。

articles.title_en: The Dark Side of Infrastructure: Roads, Repression and Land in Authoritarian Paraguay
articles.title_cn: 基础设施的阴暗面：巴拉圭威权统治下的道路、镇压与土地
articles.abstract_en: Transportation infrastructure is associated with economic development, but it can also be used for social control and to benefit the governing elite. We explore the connection between the construction of road networks, state-led repression and illegal land allocations in the longest dictatorship in South America: Alfredo Stroessner’s military regime in Paraguay. Using novel panel data from the Truth and Reconciliation Commission, we show that proximity to newly constructed roads facilitated state-led repression, illegal allocation of agricultural plots to dictatorship allies and hindered sustainable economic development in the following decades.
articles.abstract_cn: 交通基础设施与经济发展相关联，但它也可能被用于社会控制和惠及执政精英。我们探讨了南美洲持续时间最长的独裁统治——巴拉圭阿尔弗雷多·斯特罗斯纳军事政权——中道路网络建设、国家主导的镇压与非法土地分配之间的联系。利用真相与和解委员会的新面板数据，我们表明，靠近新建道路促进了国家主导的镇压、将农业地块非法分配给独裁政权盟友，并在随后的几十年中阻碍了可持续的经济发展。
